The lack of exercise this morning leaves him physically flat and somewhat stiff, a low-level physical discomfort lingering even before the workday starts.

ACCUMULATED_NARRATIVE:  
Today’s work experience for Alex was a slow, steady build of tension and fatigue, compounded by recurring conflicts that chipped away at his usual moderate trust and psychological safety. His high conscientiousness kept him pushing through interruptions and reactive tasks despite low engagement and creativity. Physical discomfort and screen fatigue deepened his weariness, while his natural agreeableness made conflict especially draining. Moments of competence affirmation from his manager provided some solace but not enough to lift the persistent undercurrent of stress and rumination. By day’s end, Alex felt depleted, his mood shadowed by frustration and social unease, yearning quietly for the weekend’s reprieve.
